mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_audit_chain(chain_id, chain_key, partition_date, shard_no, last_sequence_no, status, version, create_time, update_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{key}, #{date}, 0, 0, 'OPEN', 1, #{now}, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE chain_id=chain_id
mapper.select: SELECT chain_id id, last_sequence_no sequence, last_event_hash lastHash, status FROM t_audit_chain WHERE partition_date=#{date} AND shard_no=0 FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_audit_event(audit_event_id, chain_id, sequence_no, previous_event_hash, canonical_version, attribute_root_hash, event_hash, schema_version, actor_type, actor_id, tenant_id, action_code, resource_system, resource_type, resource_id, result, request_id, trace_id, occurred_time, received_time, payload_hash, create_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{chainId}, #{sequence}, #{previous}, 1, #{attributeHash}, #{eventHash}, 1, #{actorType}, #{actorId}, #{tenantId}, #{action}, 'PLATFORM', #{resourceType}, #{resourceId}, #{result}, #{requestId}, #{requestId}, #{now}, #{receivedAt}, #{eventHash}, #{receivedAt})

INSERT INTO t_audit_event_attr(attr_id, audit_event_id, attr_no, attr_key, value_text, value_hash, classification, create_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{eventId}, #{number}, #{key}, #{value}, #{hash}, 'INTERNAL', #{now})

INSERT INTO t_security_event(security_event_id, event_type, severity, actor_ref, tenant_id, source_system, source_event_key, source_version, source_payload_hash, schema_version, event_hash, occurred_time, create_time) VALUES(#{id}, #{action}, 'MEDIUM', #{actorId}, #{tenantId}, 'PLATFORM', #{eventId}, 1, #{hash}, 1, #{hash}, #{now}, #{receivedAt})
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN BINARY a.classification IN ('PUBLIC', 'INTERNAL') AND a.value_vault_token IS NULL THEN a.value_text WHEN BINARY a.classification IN ('CONFIDENTIAL', 'RESTRICTED') THEN a.value_masked ELSE NULL END

SELECT e.audit_event_id id, e.actor_id actorId, e.action_code actionCode, e.resource_type resourceType, e.resource_id resourceId, e.result, e.request_id requestId, e.occurred_time occurredTime, reason, a.classification reasonClassification FROM t_audit_event e LEFT JOIN t_audit_event_attr a ON a.audit_event_id=e.audit_event_id AND a.attr_no=(SELECT MIN(reason.attr_no) FROM t_audit_event_attr reason WHERE reason.audit_event_id=e.audit_event_id AND BINARY reason.attr_key='reason')
